Tickets are being accepted on London Buses, London Overground, Elizabeth line and Chiltern Railways via any reasonable route.

Trains continue to operate between Acton Town and Heathrow, all terminals. Use the METROPOLITAN LINE between Rayners Lane and Uxbridge, and ELIZABETH LINE services between Central London and Heathrow. Replacement bus services operate.
